description: Defines the CatalogItem entity class with properties and methods for managing catalog items, including updating details, brand, type, and picture URI.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the product catalog with properties such as name, description, price, picture, type, and brand, including methods to update these properties.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a catalog item with specified type, brand, description, name, price, and picture URI.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's name, description, and price after validating the inputs.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's brand based on the provided brand ID.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's type based on the provided type ID.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Sets the PictureUri property, optionally clearing it if the input is null or empty.

methods.name: CatalogItemDetails
methods.description: Immutable record struct used to pass updated details for a catalog item.
